line.en: the festival runs 13 to 15 november with its centre in the volkshaus and events across the city. pick the evening that suits; the programme is on the festival site.
line.de: das festival läuft vom 13. bis 15. november mit dem zentrum im volkshaus und veranstaltungen über die ganze stadt. such dir den passenden abend aus; das programm steht auf der festivalseite.
line.tr: festival 13 ile 15 kasım arasında sürüyor; merkezi volkshaus, etkinlikler şehrin her yerinde. sana uyan akşamı seç; program festival sitesinde.

sparks.why: BuchBasel runs 13 to 15 Nov 2026 per the basel.com events calendar; the festival centre at Volkshaus is from search snippets of buchbasel.ch. The exact Saturday event was not checked.
